tests.name: test_ctr_denominator_is_all_impressions
tests.query: SELECT SUM(impressions) = 625 AND SUM(clicked_impressions) = 18 AS ok FROM ctr_by_model_position

tests.name: test_zero_click_buckets_kept_and_unique
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT (model_version, position_bucket)) = 6 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE clicked_impressions = 0) >= 1 AS ok FROM ctr_by_model_position

tests.name: test_ctr_by_model_position_exact
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT model_version, position_bucket, impressions, clicked_impressions, ROUND(ctr::DOUBLE, 6) FROM ctr_by_model_position), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, e3, ROUND(e4::DOUBLE, 6) FROM (VALUES ('v1', '1-3', 105, 3, 0.028571), ('v1', '11+', 66, 0, 0.0), ('v1', '4-10', 234, 9, 0.038462), ('v2', '1-3', 57, 2, 0.035088), ('v2', '11+', 36, 0, 0.0), ('v2', '4-10', 127, 4, 0.031496)) v(e0, e1, e2, e3, e4)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok

tests.name: test_multi_assigned_users_excluded_and_unexposed_users_counted
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN variant = 'A' THEN users END) = 3 AND MAX(CASE WHEN variant = 'B' THEN users END) = 3 AS ok FROM experiment_metrics

tests.name: test_pre_assignment_impressions_excluded
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN variant = 'B' THEN impressions END) = 255 AS ok FROM experiment_metrics

tests.name: test_experiment_metrics_exact
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT variant, users, impressions, ROUND(ctr::DOUBLE, 6), ROUND(cart_rate::DOUBLE, 6) FROM experiment_metrics), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, ROUND(e3::DOUBLE, 6), ROUND(e4::DOUBLE, 6) FROM (VALUES ('A', 3, 227, 0.052863, 0.026432), ('B', 3, 255, 0.023529, 0.0)) v(e0, e1, e2, e3, e4)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok

tests.name: test_prediction_retries_do_not_inflate_impressions
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE item_id = 12) = 0 AND MAX(CASE WHEN item_id = 10 THEN impressions END) = 120 AS ok FROM high_score_zero_click

tests.name: test_high_score_zero_click_exact
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT item_id, impressions, ROUND(avg_score::DOUBLE, 6) FROM high_score_zero_click), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, ROUND(e2::DOUBLE, 6) FROM (VALUES (10, 120, 0.9), (13, 100, 0.75)) v(e0, e1, e2)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok
